title.note: Game title kept as branded (glossary: keep); Greek kids read Latin-script titles.

hud.cast.note: Imperative of ρίχνω, the everyday fishing verb for casting (ρίχνω πετονιά / καλάμι).

hud.reel.note: Reel in = μαζεύω την πετονιά; same root as the pass name Αυτόματο μάζεμα. Τράβα (pull!) is the other natural option for the bite moment but has no short noun for the pass.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0 and 1 read correctly (guide pattern Κέρματα: {count}); 10/10.

catch.success.note: Colon and brackets avoid case and gender agreement with inserted words (guide pattern); rarity tags are neuter like ψάρι.

catch.escaped.note: Idiomatic 'it got away from you'; single ellipsis character per the Greek guide.

catch.new_record.note: Greek writes the SI symbol kg in Latin. Developer: {weight} arrives as 12.4; Greek uses a decimal comma (12,4), so format it per locale in code.

fish.golden_carp.note: Base nominative, sentence case; also inserted as {fish}.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Invented name: eel + lantern as a noun-noun compound like λέξη-κλειδί; keeps the glowing-lantern idea. Both nouns neuter; base form for {fish}.

rarity.mythic.note: Neuter tier tag, matching Θρυλικό (Legendary) and Σπάνιο (Rare) and the implied ψάρι.

shop.rods.note: Everyday word for fishing rods (καλάμι ψαρέματος).

shop.equip.note: Verbal noun 'use', paired with the state label Σε χρήση; matches the noun-style shop button Αγορά.

shop.equipped.note: 'In use': a state, and needs no gender agreement with the rod.

shop.buy_robux.note: Verbal-noun button as in the guide's reference translation.

pass.auto_reel.note: 15 vs estimated budget 14: shortest natural wording that keeps the Reel verb (μαζεύω); no shorter Greek noun exists. The Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Το Τυχερό δόλωμα διπλασιάζει τις πιθανότητές σου για σπάνια ψάρια!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Greek needs the article before the subject; it sits outside the bold tag so the tag wraps only the pass name. 'Your chances' is idiomatic plural; double accent before σου.

sell.all.note: 'Sell them all', the natural colloquial button; 12/12.

sell.done.note: Label forms after a colon so count and coins read correctly at 1 (guide pattern).

sell.prompt.note: Latin E (U+0045), as in the guide's reference 'Πάτα E για άνοιγμα'. Source-side: phone and console players have no E key.

ascend.button.note: Neutral 'rise/ascent' for the prestige mechanic; avoids Ανάληψη (the religious Ascension) and Ανάβαση (climbing). Same word in ascend.confirm.

ascend.confirm.text: Άνοδος τώρα; Θα ξεκινήσεις από την αρχή, αλλά θα πιάνεις τα σπάνια ψάρια {bonus}% πιο συχνά.
ascend.confirm.note: Greek question mark ';'. Article 'τα' keeps σπάνια an adjective; without it 'πιάνεις σπάνια' could read as 'you rarely catch'. Imperfective θα πιάνεις = from now on.

weather.storm.text: Έρχεται καταιγίδα! Τα σπάνια ψάρια τσιμπάνε.
weather.storm.note: τσιμπάω is the fishing verb for biting. Article keeps σπάνια an adjective, not the adverb 'rarely'.

quest.catch_n.note: Count after a colon so n = 1 reads correctly. Moonlit Bay rendered as Φεγγαρόλουστος Κόλπος, declined here to the accusative after 'στον'. 38/40.

quest.claim.note: 'Take it' (the reward), the guide's reference for claim; matches the imperative quest line.

friends.boost.text: Το ψάρεμα με φίλους δίνει +{percent}% τύχη
friends.boost.note: Statement, not an order; percent with no space as in Greek.

trade.sent.note: Name after a colon so no gendered article (στον/στην) is needed, the guide's 'Ανταλλαγή με: {player}' device; 'προς' makes clear the request went to the player. 33/33.

trade.accept.note: Bare name as subject; past verbs carry no gender.

codes.enter.note: 'Type a code', the guide's placeholder; 'Enter' means type in.

codes.redeemed.text: Ο κωδικός εξαργυρώθηκε! Απόλαυσε το δώρο σου.
codes.redeemed.note: Redeem = εξαργύρωση and reward = δώρο per the guide; 45/45.

afk.kicked.text: Έμεινες πάρα πολλή ώρα χωρίς να παίζεις, οπότε το ψάρεμα σταμάτησε.
afk.kicked.note: 'You stayed too long without playing, so fishing stopped': avoids gendered adjectives like ανενεργός/ανενεργή; no mention of removal, as in the source.

event.ends.note: Developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h' with English unit letters; Greek reads '2 ημέρες 4 ώ.' (CLDR short units), so format it per locale in code.

daily.streak.text: Σερί: μέρα {day}! Έλα ξανά αύριο για κι άλλα δώρα.
daily.streak.note: Label form 'Streak: day {day}' so day = 1 needs no plural; σερί is the everyday word for a run of consecutive days. 'For more' made explicit as more rewards (δώρα), per the context note.

tip.night.text: Συμβουλή: κάποια ψάρια τσιμπάνε μόνο τη νύχτα.
tip.night.note: Συμβουλή: is the usual tip label; τσιμπάω = bite in the fishing sense.

group.join.text: Μπες στην κοινότητά μας και πάρε 50 δωρεάν δολώματα!
group.join.note: Roblox now calls groups Communities; κοινότητα per the guide ('ομάδα' means team). 'μας' (our) makes 'the group' clear as the studio's; double accent before μας.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Heaviest fish': weight, not length; ψαριά (catch) can mean a whole day's haul.
